summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. It also adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints.

findings.title: Order detail lacks owner check
findings.description: order_detail looks up the order by primary key only. It never checks that the order belongs to request.user. Any logged-in user can read the total and discount code of every order by changing the id. This exposes other customers' order data. Pass owner=request.user to get_object_or_404, as redeem already does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float
findings.description: apply_discount multiplies the Decimal total by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError when it multiplies a Decimal by a float. Every redeem request with the valid WELCOME10 code crashes with a server error. No customer can ever get the discount. Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and round to two places.

findings.title: Missing migration for discount_code
findings.description: The change adds the discount_code field to Order but adds no migration. The only migration, 0001_initial, has no discount_code column. Django selects discount_code in every Order query, and the database has no such column. Order list, order detail and redeem all fail with a database error. Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on session endpoint
findings.description: The csrf_exempt decorator turns off CSRF checks on redeem. The redeem view changes order state and authenticates with the session cookie. A third-party page can make a logged-in user's browser change that user's orders without consent. Today the impact is small, but the endpoint stays open to forged requests. Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour untested
findings.description: The repository has no test that covers apply_discount, order_detail or redeem. The new branches and ownership checks have no tests. Bugs like the Decimal crash and the missing owner check reached review without any test catching them. Add tests for discount application, the repeat-code case, and other users' access to order_detail and redeem.
